title: The Little Mermaid (The Eternal Dawn)

full_text:
Standing upon the deck of the royal ship, the little mermaid held the witch's knife over the sleeping prince. A single thrust would return her to her beloved ocean sisters and spare her life.

Yet gazing upon the prince's peaceful brow, she cast the murderous blade into the foaming sea and surrendered herself to the waves.

The rising sun caught her form, not to dissolve her into foam, but to welcome her into the fellowship of the Daughters of the Air, where every selfless deed of compassion shortens the path to eternal light.
moral: Love that surrenders its own claim to bless another receives the crown of an immortal soul.
